title: OFDM Channel Estimator
text: Estimate channel using input data and reference subcarriers, 6 inputs, 2 outputs; {Enable averaging} sets the average LS estimates, {Number of symbols to be averaged}, {Enable interpolation} sets the interpolate LS estimates, {Interpolation factor}, {Maximum number of subcarriers per symbol} and {Enable reset input port} sets the reset signal. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: numScPerSym
ports.summary: Number of valid subcarriers per OFDM symbol scalar

params.name: Number of symbols to be averaged
params.values: Number of symbols to be averaged 2 (default) | integer in range from 2 to 14

params.name: Interpolation factor
params.values: Interpolation factor 3 (default) | integer in range from 2 to 12

params.name: Maximum number of subcarriers per symbol
params.values: Maximum number of subcarriers per symbol 52 (default) | integer in range from 2 to 65, 536
